evidence: The presence of the insets introduces two optical features, a few meV below the transverse exciton energy of bulk ZnTe (2.3806 eV), respectively assigned to heavy-hole and light-hole excitons confined in CdTe potential wells. We have performed power-dependent PL measurements by exciting our samples with the single 514 nm line of an Ar+ laser. The Raman scattering of the 514 nm pumping laser line by the same 26.1 meV LO phonon of ZnTe is indicated.
